ui:help.en: Endpoint of the Azure OpenAI resource; requests go to <resource endpoint>/openai/deployments/<deployment>/chat/completions and /embeddings, where the deployment is the account's upstream model. A trailing /openai/v1 or /openai is removed.
ui:help.zh: Azure OpenAI 资源的地址，请求发往 <资源地址>/openai/deployments/<部署名>/chat/completions、/embeddings，部署名即账号的上游模型；末尾的 /openai/v1 或 /openai 会被去掉。

ui:help.en: Key of the resource, sent as api-key. Stored encrypted and never shown again.
ui:help.zh: 资源的 Key，以 api-key 发送；加密保存，保存后不再明文显示。

ui:help.en: Sent as the api-version query parameter, e.g. 2024-10-21 or 2025-04-01-preview.
ui:help.zh: 作为查询参数 api-version 发送，例如 2024-10-21、2025-04-01-preview。
